INSERT INTO edudoc_document_element (id, document_version_id, element_key, element_type, chapter_no, sequence_no, display_label, caption_text, location_json)
SELECT HEXTORAW(#{e.id}), HEXTORAW(#{e.documentVersionId}), #{e.elementKey}, #{e.elementType}, #{e.chapterNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.sequenceNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{e.displayLabel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.captionText, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{e.locationJson} AS JSON) FROM DUAL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edudoc_document_element WHERE document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(e.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(e.document_version_id) AS documentVersionId, e.element_key AS elementKey, e.element_type AS elementType, e.chapter_no AS chapterNo, e.sequence_no AS sequenceNo, e.display_label AS displayLabel, e.caption_text AS captionText, JSON_SERIALIZE(e.location_json RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000)) AS locationJson FROM edudoc_document_element e WHERE e.document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId}) ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(JSON_VALUE(e.location_json, '$.paragraphIndex'))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_document_element e WHERE e.document_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId})
